headline.text: L3 ML4 scraper generated *metal dust* in product zone, L1 S3 latch pin fell into melting tank—both resolved within shift.

summary: Two metal-in-product events today, both caught and resolved before reaching finished goods. L1 S4 running without proper packaging due to bag/box shortage—QA approved slip-sheet workaround. L1 S2 found foreign material in chocolate sock filter; metal detector did not detect it on recheck.

food_safety.title: S3 melting-tank latch pin fell into chocolate
food_safety.summary: Latch knob disconnected, stainless pin dropped into AD1 melting tank at 00:49; pump stopped immediately, pin retrieved with magnet by 01:28.
food_safety.status: Resolved—pin recovered, bagged, tank returned to service.

food_safety.title: S2 foreign material in chocolate sock—MD did not detect
food_safety.summary: Operators found debris (possible temper-cup fragment) in first sock filter at 05:42; ran trays through metal detector for verification—MD did not hit.
food_safety.status: Open—material found in sock, second sock clear; MD performance under review.

food_safety.title: TG5 scraper misaligned—metal dust generated
food_safety.summary: Scrapers installed wrong on TG5, rubbing rollers and creating metal dust in product zone; line stopped at 07:32, maintenance corrected by 08:15.

quality.title: S4 out of bags and boxes—using slip sheets
quality.summary: L1 S4 exhausted 21182 WIP bags and boxes mid-shift; QA approved temporary use of slip sheets top/bottom of pallets to protect loose product.
quality.status: Open—slip-sheet workaround in place, procurement working replenishment.

quality.title: 3 damaged chocolate pallets
quality.summary: Fork damage on 3 pallets of chocolate; lead scraped affected chocolate from damaged areas per Nathan Gevenois approval.
quality.status: Resolved—scraped material handled, pallets dispositioned by production.

opportunities.text: Review S3 melting-tank latch hardware PM schedule—two latches failed within 2 hours (AD1 pin dropped, AD2 pin stuck), suggesting wear-out mode.
Audit S2 metal-detector sensitivity—debris found in chocolate sock did not trigger reject when test-passed through MD at 06:05.
Review S4 packaging min/max—line ran out of bags/boxes mid-shift with no on-site backup, requiring non-standard slip-sheet workaround.
Consider adding scraper position/clearance verification to ML4 TG5 startup checklist—today's misalignment generated metal dust before operators caught it.
